label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. If a cookie banner offers no way to decline that works, accept it, report that as a problem, and carry on. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: Pressing Enter on the footer [name] link did nothing I could perceive: the page and title stayed the same and no message told me whether it was loading. I had to use the Sheets menu instead.

Product links in the list have very long names made of badges, several image descriptions, the title and the price run together, so every product sounds like a wall of text and the real product name is buried in the middle.

element.name: Overhead image of Signature [name] Standard sham in White Overhead image of Signature [name] King Sham in White Signature [name] Sham From [name]-promotional price: $39 4 Colors

findings.problem: After I pressed Add to bag the button lost its name and became an unnamed button, and nothing told me the item was added. Only on a second read did I learn that a cart drawer had opened, so I could not tell if it worked.

The cart drawer is full of extra things before the checkout link: close and announcement buttons, a remove button called cart remove item, upsell products with unlabeled links and repeated Color and Size dropdowns, and a gift note checkbox. The Proceed to Checkout link comes at the very end, so it is hard to find.

Right after choosing Proceed to Checkout the page was almost empty (only a heading, an empty main area and an empty heading) with no loading message, so I did not know if the page was broken or still loading until I read it again.
